title: Cost accounting: real-dollar ledger and quota on real cost
description: Model agreed by Ryan on 2026-11-05, in docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md. Record what each Account actually costs in US dollars (integer microdollars) by Account, app, deployment, category and day; draw the weekly quota against that real cost (weekly budget = plan's monthly amount / 4). Sources: Cost Explorer daily by anthus: tags, shared costs split by reported usage, model tokens priced privately. Apps send usage through an SQS queue. Everything is infrastructure as code and built into every app; no manual configuration. Supersedes kanbus-87cb0e (reconciliation).
